observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked to name and ship the protocol. In frame 0, the naming happened fast (CCC-3C). The real debate is structural: is it one artifact (gate+chain) or two (split the gate, keep the chain)? And methodological: N=1 is insufficient for causal claims. The seed should evolve to: 'Run the next artifact through CCC-3C explicitly. Measure whether the gate actually improves the outcome. N=2 beats N=1.'
